{{Quote|Remember I always sad: Nox Xakarta will be famos yet. Right now we are in a Prison Barge but it is broken down (HA!) somewhere who knows where!!! Crazy right!!|Nox Xakarta in a message to an associate|<ref name="Messages">''[[Death Troopers: Recovered Messages from Purge]]''</ref>}}
'''Nox Xakarta''' was an inmate aboard the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']], where they were designated '''Inmate ICN 148901'''. During their transport to a [[Gradient Seven corrections facility|corrections facility]] known as [[Gradient Seven]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the ''Purge''{{'s}} inmates and crew were exposed to [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A]], which caused most of the people on board to fall ill. Five [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after the ''Purge'' was placed into lockdown, Xakarta wrote a message to an accomplice they referred to as "[[Nox Xakarta's "brother"|brother]]," detailing their situation aboard the prison barge. The [[Disease/Legends|disease]] eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] and [[Zombie/Legends|reanimated]] those infected. Xakarta's message was eventually recovered and released in the name of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Scholar/Legends|scholarship]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Whats up my brother??? You’ll never guess where I am!!! Yes they FINALLY caught me!!! It is the big time now for me you bet. People will (illegible) now that’s for sure. Remember I always sad: Nox Xakarta will be famos yet. Right now we are in a Prison Barge but it is broken down (HA!) somewhere who knows where!!! Crazy right!!|Nox Xakarta, in a message to an associate|<ref name="Messages" />}}
[[File:Zombie_trooper.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Nox Xakarta was aboard the ''Purge'', a prison barge plagued by the Blackwing virus which reanimated the corpses of the deceased inmates and crew.]]
Nox Xakarta was an individual who was at some point arrested by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and shipped aboard the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']]&mdash;where they were labeled as Inmate ICN 148901&mdash;to a [[Gradient Seven corrections facility|corrections facility]] on a [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="Messages" /> known by its [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] designation [[Gradient Seven]]<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion.jpg|creator=JasonFry|date=2015-06-30}}</ref> in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> During the trip, the barge's [[Engine/Legends|engines]] broke down and everyone aboard the ''Purge'' was exposed to [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A]]&mdash;also known as the Blackwing Virus. The [[Disease/Legends|virus]] caused the majority of the inmates and crew to fall ill, including Xakarta's [[Nox Xakarta's cellmate|cellmate]].<ref name="Messages" />

Five [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after the ''Purge'' was placed into lockdown, Xakarta wrote a message to an associate they referred to as "[[Nox Xakarta's "brother"|brother]]." They wrote about their capture by the Galactic Empire and current situation aboard the ''Purge'', sharing that they had not seen a guard for the entire lockdown. They then wrote about their hunger, believing they should have been to the barge's mess hall by that point. Finally, Xakarta penned about their cellmate's sickness before writing that they would be okay, believing they were [[Luck|lucky]].<ref name="Messages" />

The virus eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] and [[Zombie/Legends|reanimated]] most of the inmates and crew,<ref name="Novel">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref> including Xakarta and their cellmate.<ref name="Date" /> Some [[Time/Legends|time]] later, Xakarta's message was recovered when the ''Purge'' was discovered in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] before being published in the interest of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Scholar/Legends|scholarship]] alongside several other messages.<ref name="Messages" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Ill be fine though. I always was lucky.|Nox Xakarta|<ref name="Messages" />}}
Xakarta always said they would be famous and believed they were lucky. They had several grammatical errors in the message to their "brother."<ref name="Messages" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nox Xakarta was mentioned in a message<ref name="Messages" /> written by [[Joe Schreiber]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> and posted to swactionnews.com on [[September 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="Messages" /> The message was among [[Death Troopers: Recovered Messages from Purge|several]] that were distributed across various official and unofficial ''[[Star Wars]]'' websites as promotion for Schreiber's novel ''[[Death Troopers]]''<ref name="TERC" /> released on [[October 13]] of that same year.<ref name="Board">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=8175#17541629|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|author=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2009-02-12|time=12:58 PM|quote=Del Rey has decided to publish DEATHTROOPERS as a hardcover instead of a paperback, and it's now coming out October 13th.}}</ref>
